title: Landing page
caption: The public home page: what VentureScope does and how a plan becomes a forecast, a scenario and a report.
what_to_notice: The headline, the platform cards and the promise of a free stack with no paid APIs.
alt_text: Landing page in VentureScope. The public home page: what VentureScope does and how a plan becomes a forecast, a scenario and a report.

title: Live demo
caption: A read-only tour of the Orbit Analytics sample company, with Base, Bull and Bear scenarios and no sign-up.
what_to_notice: Switch the scenario tabs and watch the charts and tables change.
alt_text: Live demo in VentureScope. A read-only tour of the Orbit Analytics sample company, with Base, Bull and Bear scenarios and no sign-up.

title: Help center
caption: Answers, key terms and how the numbers work, in plain English.
what_to_notice: The help page is open to everyone, even before sign-in.
alt_text: Help center in VentureScope. Answers, key terms and how the numbers work, in plain English.

title: Privacy notice
caption: What VentureScope stores and why.
what_to_notice: Short sections in plain words, with the date of the last update.
alt_text: Privacy notice in VentureScope. What VentureScope stores and why.

title: Terms
caption: The rules for using VentureScope.
what_to_notice: Same layout as the privacy notice, so both documents read the same way.
alt_text: Terms in VentureScope. The rules for using VentureScope.

title: Sign in
caption: Email and password sign-in that sends you back to the page you asked for.
what_to_notice: A show-password button, and a Forgot password link that leads to the recovery-key reset.
alt_text: Sign in in VentureScope. Email and password sign-in that sends you back to the page you asked for.

title: Create an account
caption: Registration with a name, an email and a password that is typed twice.
what_to_notice: Each field shows its own clear message when something is wrong.
alt_text: Create an account in VentureScope. Registration with a name, an email and a password that is typed twice.

title: Forgot password
caption: Password reset without any email: enter your email, your saved recovery key and a new password.
what_to_notice: VentureScope sends no emails, so the recovery key replaces the usual reset link.
alt_text: Forgot password in VentureScope. Password reset without any email: enter your email, your saved recovery key and a new password.

title: Page not found
caption: A not-found page that helps: it explains what happened and offers ways to go on.
what_to_notice: No dead end: links and suggestions instead of an empty error.
alt_text: Page not found in VentureScope. A not-found page that helps: it explains what happened and offers ways to go on.

title: Dashboard
caption: The home of a signed-in person: every financial model with live portfolio numbers and a needs-attention panel.
what_to_notice: Model cards, portfolio KPIs and attention items marked Critical, Watch or Setup.
alt_text: Dashboard in VentureScope. The home of a signed-in person: every financial model with live portfolio numbers and a needs-attention panel.

title: Search with Ctrl/Cmd + K
caption: Press Ctrl or Cmd + K anywhere in the app to jump to a model or a page.
what_to_notice: Models, workspace pages and help pages in one list that works with the arrow keys and Enter.
alt_text: Search with Ctrl/Cmd + K in VentureScope. Press Ctrl or Cmd + K anywhere in the app to jump to a model or a page.

title: Mobile menu
caption: On a phone the side menu becomes a menu button, and every page stays reachable.
what_to_notice: Workspace and account links in one drop-down menu.
alt_text: Mobile menu in VentureScope. On a phone the side menu becomes a menu button, and every page stays reachable.

title: Workspaces
caption: Teams and shared models: create a workspace, accept invitations and see the workspaces you belong to.
what_to_notice: Owner, editor and viewer roles decide who can change what.
alt_text: Workspaces in VentureScope. Teams and shared models: create a workspace, accept invitations and see the workspaces you belong to.

title: Workspace detail
caption: One workspace with its shared models, its collaborators and roles, invitation links and owner actions.
what_to_notice: Invitation links are one-time links that work for 7 days.
alt_text: Workspace detail in VentureScope. One workspace with its shared models, its collaborators and roles, invitation links and owner actions.

title: Create a model
caption: Start a model with company, industry, currency and forecast horizon, open a ready-made example, or restore a backup.
what_to_notice: Base, Bull and Bear scenarios are created automatically.
alt_text: Create a model in VentureScope. Start a model with company, industry, currency and forecast horizon, open a ready-made example, or restore a backup.

title: Profile
caption: Your display name and account details, and the button to download all of your data.
what_to_notice: Download my data returns one ZIP file with your models as JSON and CSV.
alt_text: Profile in VentureScope. Your display name and account details, and the button to download all of your data.

title: Account security
caption: Email, password, recovery key, active sessions and account deletion in one place.
what_to_notice: A security check-up card gives three plain facts about the account.
alt_text: Account security in VentureScope. Email, password, recovery key, active sessions and account deletion in one place.

title: Model overview
caption: The overview of one model: key numbers and charts calculated from the assumptions.
what_to_notice: The header shows currency, horizon, number of scenarios and revenue mode on every model page.
alt_text: Model overview in VentureScope. The overview of one model: key numbers and charts calculated from the assumptions.

title: Assumptions
caption: Starting cash, tax rate, cost of goods sold and operating costs. They drive every forecast.
what_to_notice: One source of numbers: forecast, scenarios and reports all read these assumptions.
alt_text: Assumptions in VentureScope. Starting cash, tax rate, cost of goods sold and operating costs. They drive every forecast.

title: Revenue assumptions
caption: How the business earns money: customers, price per customer, churn, acquisition cost and organic sign-ups.
what_to_notice: Fields accept numbers pasted from a spreadsheet.
alt_text: Revenue assumptions in VentureScope. How the business earns money: customers, price per customer, churn, acquisition cost and organic sign-ups.

title: Expense assumptions
caption: Payroll, rent, marketing, cost of goods sold and other recurring operating expenses.
what_to_notice: Each cost is set on its own, so the forecast shows what drives the burn.
alt_text: Expense assumptions in VentureScope. Payroll, rent, marketing, cost of goods sold and other recurring operating expenses.

title: Financing
caption: Equity rounds, debt, grants and other financing events. Financing changes cash flow, never operating revenue.
what_to_notice: Financing events appear in the cash-flow forecast and the runway.
alt_text: Financing in VentureScope. Equity rounds, debt, grants and other financing events. Financing changes cash flow, never operating revenue.

title: Planning timeline
caption: One-off monthly changes (overrides) without touching the long-term baseline.
what_to_notice: Global overrides apply first, and scenario overrides take precedence.
alt_text: Planning timeline in VentureScope. One-off monthly changes (overrides) without touching the long-term baseline.

title: Financial forecast
caption: Monthly and annual forecasts generated from the assumptions by one deterministic engine.
what_to_notice: P&L, cash flow and reports read the same forecast, so the numbers always agree.
alt_text: Financial forecast in VentureScope. Monthly and annual forecasts generated from the assumptions by one deterministic engine.

title: Profit and loss
caption: Revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, EBITDA and net income.
what_to_notice: A table you can scroll sideways with the keyboard on a small screen.
alt_text: Profit and loss in VentureScope. Revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, EBITDA and net income.

title: Cash flow
caption: A simplified cash-flow forecast: operating cash flow, financing, debt repayment, burn and runway.
what_to_notice: Runway shows how many months the cash lasts.
alt_text: Cash flow in VentureScope. A simplified cash-flow forecast: operating cash flow, financing, debt repayment, burn and runway.

title: Customer analytics
caption: Acquisition, churn, active customers, price per customer and monthly recurring revenue.
what_to_notice: The customer engine moves every month with acquisition and churn.
alt_text: Customer analytics in VentureScope. Acquisition, churn, active customers, price per customer and monthly recurring revenue.

title: Scenario analysis
caption: Stress-test the model with Base, Bull, Bear and custom scenarios.
what_to_notice: Each scenario runs through the same engine. Only its modifiers differ.
alt_text: Scenario analysis in VentureScope. Stress-test the model with Base, Bull, Bear and custom scenarios.

title: Scenario comparison
caption: Compare scenarios side by side and see which drivers differ and how far each one is from the reference.
what_to_notice: Pick any scenario as the reference.
alt_text: Scenario comparison in VentureScope. Compare scenarios side by side and see which drivers differ and how far each one is from the reference.

title: Sensitivity lab
caption: Explore combinations of revenue downside and cost inflation and what they do to liquidity and the cash floor.
what_to_notice: Revenue downside and cost inflation are changed together, not one at a time.
alt_text: Sensitivity lab in VentureScope. Explore combinations of revenue downside and cost inflation and what they do to liquidity and the cash floor.

title: Advanced analytics
caption: Valuation, operating efficiency, unit economics, cash-generation quality and DCF sensitivity.
what_to_notice: All figures come from the current forecast.
alt_text: Advanced analytics in VentureScope. Valuation, operating efficiency, unit economics, cash-generation quality and DCF sensitivity.

title: Actuals vs forecast
caption: Actual monthly results against the plan, with favorable and unfavorable variances.
what_to_notice: The demo has nine months of results, and the newest month has just ended.
alt_text: Actuals vs forecast in VentureScope. Actual monthly results against the plan, with favorable and unfavorable variances.

title: Forecast accuracy
caption: How closely the plan tracked reality, whether the forecast is biased, and whether it is getting better.
what_to_notice: Bias shows if the plan is too low or too high month after month.
alt_text: Forecast accuracy in VentureScope. How closely the plan tracked reality, whether the forecast is biased, and whether it is getting better.

title: Variance review
caption: Explain why actuals differed from the forecast, classify root causes and track corrective actions.
what_to_notice: Commentary is linked to the month it explains.
alt_text: Variance review in VentureScope. Explain why actuals differed from the forecast, classify root causes and track corrective actions.

title: KPI scorecard
caption: KPI targets compared with actuals, the live forecast, runway and past forecast accuracy.
what_to_notice: Targets are goals set by management, not forecasts.
alt_text: KPI scorecard in VentureScope. KPI targets compared with actuals, the live forecast, runway and past forecast accuracy.

title: Financial close
caption: Lock finished months so numbers cannot change silently, and keep a record of every close and reopen.
what_to_notice: The demo closes the first six months and reopens one with an approval.
alt_text: Financial close in VentureScope. Lock finished months so numbers cannot change silently, and keep a record of every close and reopen.

title: Data import center
caption: Preview, validate and apply CSV files for actuals, KPI targets and variance comments, with an import history.
what_to_notice: A file is checked before anything is written, and the history shows what was loaded.
alt_text: Data import center in VentureScope. Preview, validate and apply CSV files for actuals, KPI targets and variance comments, with an import history.

title: Planning cycle
caption: Freeze approved plans as baselines, compare them with the live forecast and build a rolling outlook from actuals.
what_to_notice: The demo has two baselines: the original budget and the forecast after the price change.
alt_text: Planning cycle in VentureScope. Freeze approved plans as baselines, compare them with the live forecast and build a rolling outlook from actuals.

title: Liquidity risk center
caption: Cash guardrails, runway, monthly burn, EBITDA resilience and downside liquidity.
what_to_notice: Rules set by the company turn the numbers into clear warnings.
alt_text: Liquidity risk center in VentureScope. Cash guardrails, runway, monthly burn, EBITDA resilience and downside liquidity.

title: Capital planning
caption: The size of the funding gap, and what equity, debt or a mix would do to cash, dilution and debt service.
what_to_notice: Three funding structures are compared on the same page.
alt_text: Capital planning in VentureScope. The size of the funding gap, and what equity, debt or a mix would do to cash, dilution and debt service.

title: Decision center
caption: Turn financial exceptions into prioritized decisions with owners, due dates and statuses.
what_to_notice: The demo has decisions in several statuses, such as open, in progress and blocked.
alt_text: Decision center in VentureScope. Turn financial exceptions into prioritized decisions with owners, due dates and statuses.

title: Planning templates
caption: Industry reference models to compare assumptions, KPIs and risks for common business types.
what_to_notice: A starting point for a planning talk, not a prediction.
alt_text: Planning templates in VentureScope. Industry reference models to compare assumptions, KPIs and risks for common business types.

title: Approval center
caption: Formal approval of important decisions, with separate requester and approver and a recorded reason.
what_to_notice: The demo has requests that are approved, rejected and still waiting.
alt_text: Approval center in VentureScope. Formal approval of important decisions, with separate requester and approver and a recorded reason.

title: Activity center
caption: An unchangeable audit trail of closes, decisions, targets, comments and reviews.
what_to_notice: Events are spread over the whole story, because each one is written on its own day.
alt_text: Activity center in VentureScope. An unchangeable audit trail of closes, decisions, targets, comments and reviews.

title: Version history
caption: Save checkpoints and restore an earlier model without rewriting history.
what_to_notice: The demo has three saved versions: Seed plan, Pricing update and Retention programme.
alt_text: Version history in VentureScope. Save checkpoints and restore an earlier model without rewriting history.

title: Model diff
caption: Compare two saved versions and see exactly what changed: assumptions, scenarios, financing or settings.
what_to_notice: The result tells which part of the model changed.
alt_text: Model diff in VentureScope. Compare two saved versions and see exactly what changed: assumptions, scenarios, financing or settings.

title: Board room
caption: Run executive reviews, freeze a snapshot of the numbers and compare it later with the live model.
what_to_notice: The demo has a frozen board review of the latest month.
alt_text: Board room in VentureScope. Run executive reviews, freeze a snapshot of the numbers and compare it later with the live model.

title: Board pack
caption: A board-ready report package that can be printed or saved as a PDF.
what_to_notice: The page is built for print, so the menus disappear on paper.
alt_text: Board pack in VentureScope. A board-ready report package that can be printed or saved as a PDF.

title: Alert inbox
caption: Current management exceptions about liquidity, funding, KPIs, close and governance in one list.
what_to_notice: The inbox collects signals from other pages and does not repeat their calculations.
alt_text: Alert inbox in VentureScope. Current management exceptions about liquidity, funding, KPIs, close and governance in one list.

title: Portfolio dashboard
caption: Compare the models you can access, see where attention is needed and the liquidity by currency.
what_to_notice: Every row opens the decision or reporting page of that model.
alt_text: Portfolio dashboard in VentureScope. Compare the models you can access, see where attention is needed and the liquidity by currency.

title: Consolidation center
caption: Convert and add up the models of a workspace in one reporting currency, with dated exchange rates entered by hand.
what_to_notice: Missing rates are shown clearly, never guessed.
alt_text: Consolidation center in VentureScope. Convert and add up the models of a workspace in one reporting currency, with dated exchange rates entered by hand.

title: Executive report
caption: A report with CSV and PDF export, made without any paid service.
what_to_notice: Sample exports are saved in the exports folder of the portfolio.
alt_text: Executive report in VentureScope. A report with CSV and PDF export, made without any paid service.

title: Release readiness
caption: A read-only page with the capability map, governance controls and the expectations for a production release.
what_to_notice: It shows what the product can do and how it is controlled, in one place.
alt_text: Release readiness in VentureScope. A read-only page with the capability map, governance controls and the expectations for a production release.

title: Model settings
caption: Model details, structure settings and explicit operations such as sharing, copying and deleting.
what_to_notice: Dangerous actions ask for confirmation.
alt_text: Model settings in VentureScope. Model details, structure settings and explicit operations such as sharing, copying and deleting.
